fields.name: faq_id
fields.description: Unique identifier for an FAQ record.

fields.name: category
fields.description: Topic category assigned to the FAQ.

fields.name: answer
fields.description: Answer text; verify against official SEEU sources before publication.

fields.name: source_url
fields.description: URL or source reference supporting the answer; use verification status if not verified.

fields.name: last_verified
fields.description: Date source was last checked in YYYY-MM-DD format, or NOT_VERIFIED.

rules: Required fields must not be empty.
Do not present unverified information as official.
